purpose: 6-step agent workflow rendered as a literal vertical flowchart with SVG connector paths and tag pills between steps.

constraints.note: 6 = 1 opening prompt wrap (.process_step1, no title/body, prompt+tag only) + 5 real STAGES entries (title+body+tag/null). Verified against src/components/Process.jsx:119-161 — the 5th stage's tag/connector are both null (it is the closing stage).

responsive.desktop: 940x369 inline SVG connectors, mirrored ltr/rtl variants, -6px bottom margin so paths butt together.

mobile.change: connector geometry swaps to a 296x320 zig-zag path (or 149x320 half variant for the closing step) — a distinct path set, not a scaled version of the desktop path.

motion.pattern: scroll-linked connector draw-in per step, tag pill fade-in
motion.reducedMotionFallback: static full connectors, tags at rest opacity
